name: Brine Road East & The Golbat Leap
summary: Equip the Golbat Boots obtained in Johto's Ice Mountains to leap across the ruptured deck chasm of the Old Shipwreck, unlocking the eastern half of Brine Road. Surf east through sparkling island channels towards Kin Island. Collect valuable training supplies including Carbos, HP Up, a Big Pearl, a hidden Heart Scale, and TM16 Light Screen resting on an offshore reef. Take note of the dense pod of Corsola blocking the southern channel towards the Water Labyrinth — they will require a predator to disperse.

items.name: TM16 Light Screen
items.method: On a small coral sandbar on the eastern perimeter

items.name: Carbos
items.method: Floating near the northern rocky shoals

items.name: HP Up
items.method: Hidden in the coral reef near the central channel

items.name: Big Pearl
items.method: On an islet south of the Kin Island sea gate
